proof_body:
by
  intro a α β hab
  have hcongr : (∫ x in α..β, |a * (x - α) * (x - β)|) = ∫ x in α..β, -|a| * ((x - α) * (x - β)) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at hx
    have : (x - α) * (x - β) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith [hx.1]) (by linarith [hx.2])
    rw [mul_assoc, abs_mul, abs_of_nonpos this]
    ring
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc α β, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x - α) ^ 3 / 3 - (β - α) * (x - α) ^ 2 / 2) ((x - α) * (x - β)) x := by
    intro x _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x - α) 1 x := (hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const α
    exact (((h1.fun_pow 3).div_const 3).fun_sub (((h1.fun_pow 2).const_mul (β - α)).div_const 2)).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
  rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x - α) * (x - β)).intervalIntegrable α β)]
  ring
